author: ahai
name: gradle
notes: Gradle needs a JDK. Mirrors and usage: https://github.com/version-fox/vfox-gradle/blob/main/README.md

shadowHints.message: SDKMAN! installed its own Gradle. Run `sdk uninstall gradle` or take its candidate directory out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
mise installed its own Gradle (a shim). Run `mise uninstall gradle` or take the shims directory out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
asdf installed its own Gradle (a shim in the shims directory). Run `asdf uninstall gradle` or take the shims directory out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
Homebrew installed its own Gradle. Run `brew uninstall gradle` or take it out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
Homebrew installed its own Gradle. Run `brew uninstall gradle` or take it out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
Linuxbrew installed its own Gradle. Run `brew uninstall gradle` or take it out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
Chocolatey installed its own Gradle. Run `choco uninstall gradle` or take it out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
Scoop installed its own Gradle. Run `scoop uninstall gradle` or take it out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
WinGet installed its own Gradle. Run `winget uninstall Gradle.Gradle` or take it out of PATH so vfox's Gradle runs.
Another Gradle is earlier on PATH, so `gradle` does not run the version vfox selected. Remove it from PATH or put vfox first (`vfox config path.mode baseline`).
